name: idSamp_eq
header:
theorem idSamp_eq (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) :
    G.idSamp n = (ProbComp.sample (G.IdDraw n)).bind fun d => .pure (G.idCore n d)

name: game_eq
header:
theorem game_eq (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    G.game A real n =
      (G.idSamp n).bind fun I =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin n → Bool)).bind fun σ =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (G.outLen n) → Bool)).bind fun u =>
      (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins n)).bind fun r =>
        .pure (A.distinguisherL n
          (G.challengeStr n I (if real then G.eval n I σ else u)) r)

name: adv_eq
header:
theorem adv_eq (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ) :
    G.adv A n = Games.advantage (G.game A true n) (G.game A false n)

name: jointLaw_eq
header:
theorem jointLaw_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    P.jointLaw κ pp = (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I =>
      (fun x => (I, x)) <$> P.sdSampFull κ pp I

name: errProb_eq
header:
theorem errProb_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    P.errProb κ pp = ProbComp.prob
      ((P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => P.sdSampFull κ pp I) (fun x => x.err = true)

name: errProb_le_decomposition
header:
theorem errProb_le_decomposition (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    P.errProb κ pp ≤
      ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => P.Cond3 κ pp x.1) +
      (∑ k : Fin κ, ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp)
        (fun x => P.Cond2 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k ∧ ¬ P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k)) +
      ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => ∀ k, P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k)

name: G4_eval_eq
header:
theorem G4_eval_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) :
    (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).AllOutputs (fun x => ∀ j,
      MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim x.seed.1 x.seed.2) (P.G4 κ pp I j) =
        if x.err then 0 else
          ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 x.σ (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p))

name: eval'_correct
header:
theorem eval'_correct (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) :
    (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).AllOutputs (fun x => ∀ j,
      P.eval' κ pp I x.seed j =
        if x.err then false else P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 x.σ (P.outputIndex κ j))

name: idSamp_eq
header:
theorem idSamp_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) :
    S.idSamp κ = S.idCore κ <$> ProbComp.sample (S.IdDraw κ)

name: sdSamp_eq
header:
theorem sdSamp_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) :
    S.sdSamp κ I = S.sdCore κ I <$> ProbComp.sample (S.SdDraw κ I)

name: game_eq
header:
theorem game_eq (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) :
    S.game A real κ = (S.idSamp κ).bind fun I => (S.sdSamp κ I).bind fun sd =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (S.outLen κ) → Bool)).bind fun z =>
      (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r =>
      pure (A.distinguisherL κ (S.challengeStr κ I sd.1
        (if real then S.eval κ I sd else z)) r)

name: adv_eq
header:
theorem adv_eq (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) :
    S.adv A κ = advantage (S.game A true κ) (S.game A false κ)

name: hasComplexity_iff
header:
theorem hasComplexity_iff (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) :
    S.HasComplexity dPub dPriv ↔ ∀ κ (I : S.Idx κ), ∃ Q :
      Fin (S.outLen κ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ))
        (ZMod (S.modulus κ)),
      (∀ j, pubDegree (Q j) ≤ dPub ∧ privDegree (Q j) ≤ dPriv) ∧
      (S.sdSamp κ I).AllOutputs fun sd => ∀ j,
        ((S.eval κ I sd j).toNat : ZMod (S.modulus κ)) =
          MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (Q j)

name: hasComplexityEff_iff
header:
theorem hasComplexityEff_iff (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) :
    S.HasComplexityEff dPub dPriv ↔
    ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ κ (I : S.Idx κ),
      ∃ Q : Fin (S.outLen κ) →
        MvPolynomial (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ)) (ZMod (S.modulus κ)),
      (∀ j, ∃ ts : PolyTerms (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ))
          (ZMod (S.modulus κ)),
        f (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode (S.encPP κ)
          (pairEncode (S.encIdx κ I) (PolyTerms.encFin j)))) =
          PolyTerms.encTerms (fun z => Candidates.natToList (S.residueBits.eval κ) z.val)
            (fun v => PolyTerms.encFin (finSumFinEquiv v)) ts ∧ PolyTerms.denote ts = Q j) ∧
      (∀ j, pubDegree (Q j) ≤ dPub ∧ privDegree (Q j) ≤ dPriv) ∧
      (S.sdSamp κ I).AllOutputs fun sd => ∀ j,
        ((S.eval κ I sd j).toNat : ZMod (S.modulus κ)) =
          MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (Q j)

name: chainGame_eq
header:
theorem chainGame_eq (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (tailReal : Bool) (i κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.chainGame A tailReal i κ pp =
      (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I =>
      (ProbComp.sample (P.Draw κ pp)).bind fun d =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p)).bind fun u =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.m κ) → Bool)).bind fun w =>
      (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r =>
        pure (A.distinguisherL κ
          (P.challengeStr κ pp I (P.publicSeed κ pp (P.chainPublic κ pp I d u i) false)
            (if tailReal then fun j => P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 d.1
              (P.outputIndex κ j) else w)) r)

name: hyb_eq
header:
theorem hyb_eq (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (stage : HybridStage) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.hyb A stage κ pp =
      (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).bind fun x =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.m κ) → Bool)).bind fun w =>
      (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r =>
        let clean

name: hyb_real_eq_raw
header:
theorem hyb_real_eq_raw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) :
    P.hyb A .real κ (π κ) = (jlsSPRG_raw P π).game A true κ

name: hyb_random_eq_raw
header:
theorem hyb_random_eq_raw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) :
    P.hyb A .random κ (π κ) = (jlsSPRG_raw P π).game A false κ

name: hyb_prg_accept_eq_chain_zero
header:
theorem hyb_prg_accept_eq_chain_zero (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    accept (P.hyb A .prg κ pp) = accept (P.chainGame A true 0 κ pp)

name: hyb_uniform_accept_eq_chain_zero
header:
theorem hyb_uniform_accept_eq_chain_zero (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    accept (P.hyb A .uniform κ pp) = accept (P.chainGame A false 0 κ pp)

name: sampleLaw_eq
header:
theorem sampleLaw_eq (F : Raw) (ℓ : ℕ) :
    F.sampleLaw ℓ = (ProbComp.sample (F.Draw ℓ)).bind fun r =>
      .pure (F.sampleCore ℓ r)

name: lpn_hop
header:
theorem lpn_hop (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT)
    (tails : ℕ → Bool) (hops : ∀ κ, Fin (κ + 1)) :
    ∃ w : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L, ∀ B : NUPPT,
      B.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var)
        (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (w L) x r) →
      ∀ κ, (hops κ).val < κ →
        Games.advantage (P.chainGame A (tails κ) (hops κ).val κ (π κ))
          (P.chainGame A (tails κ) ((hops κ).val + 1) κ (π κ)) ≤
            (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv B (P.ℓ κ)

name: prg_hop
header:
theorem prg_hop (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) :
    ∃ ω : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N, ∀ B : NUPPT,
      B.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var)
        (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ω N) x r) →
      ∀ κ, Games.advantage (P.chainGame A true κ κ (π κ))
          (P.chainGame A false κ κ (π κ)) ≤ P.G.adv B (P.n κ)

name: idSamp'_eq
header:
theorem idSamp'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) :
    P.idSamp' κ pp = P.idCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (P.IdDraw κ pp)

name: sdSampFull_eq
header:
theorem sdSampFull_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) :
    P.sdSampFull κ pp I = P.sdCore κ pp I <$> ProbComp.sample (P.Draw κ pp)

name: sdSamp'_eq
header:
theorem sdSamp'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) :
    P.sdSamp' κ pp I = (fun x => x.seed) <$> P.sdSampFull κ pp I

name: jlsSPRG_raw_idSamp
header:
theorem jlsSPRG_raw_idSamp (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) :
    (jlsSPRG_raw P π).idSamp κ = P.idSamp' κ (π κ)

name: jlsSPRG_raw_sdSamp
header:
theorem jlsSPRG_raw_sdSamp (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ)
    (I : P.Idx' κ (π κ)) :
    (jlsSPRG_raw P π).sdSamp κ I = P.sdSamp' κ (π κ) I

name: lemma42
header:
theorem lemma42 (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) :
    ∃ (ωL : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L) (ωG : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N),
      ∀ BL BG : NUPPT,
        BL.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var)
          (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (ωL L) x r) →
        BG.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var)
          (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ωG N) x r) →
        ∀ κ, advantage (P.chainGame A true 0 κ (π κ))
          (P.chainGame A false κ κ (π κ)) ≤
            (κ : ℝ) * (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv BL (P.ℓ κ) + P.G.adv BG (P.n κ)
